title: Page Builder

fields.label: Page Sections
fields.name: page_sections
fields.instructions: Add and reorder the sections for this page.

sub_fields.label: Dropdown links
sub_fields.name: children
sub_fields.instructions: Leave empty for a link with no menu.

sub_fields.label: Surface
sub_fields.name: tone
sub_fields.instructions: Light is the white card. The first card is light when this is empty.

sub_fields.label: Italic phrase
sub_fields.name: emphasis
sub_fields.instructions: Words from the title that should be italic.

sub_fields.label: Icon
sub_fields.name: icon
sub_fields.instructions: Shown in the circle. Cards use gear, people, person, then target when this is empty.

sub_fields.label: Anchor
sub_fields.name: anchor
sub_fields.instructions: Used in the page address, such as foundation.

sub_fields.label: Offerings
sub_fields.name: items
sub_fields.instructions: Two columns. A last item with no pair spans the row.

sub_fields.label: Image
sub_fields.name: image
sub_fields.instructions: Optional. The card shows the title and text when no image is set.

sub_fields.label: Italic word
sub_fields.name: highlight
sub_fields.instructions: The word in the title that is italic, such as their.

sub_fields.label: Cards
sub_fields.name: cards
sub_fields.instructions: Cards scroll sideways. A photo is optional.

sub_fields.label: Image
sub_fields.name: image
sub_fields.instructions: Optional. The card shows the title and text when no image is set.

sub_fields.label: Columns
sub_fields.name: columns
sub_fields.instructions: The featured column is the dark Finance column.

sub_fields.label: Logo
sub_fields.name: logo
sub_fields.instructions: Shown instead of the column label when this column is featured.

sub_fields.label: Rows
sub_fields.name: rows
sub_fields.instructions: Values: one yes or no per line, in column order.

sub_fields.label: Values
sub_fields.name: values
sub_fields.instructions: One yes or no per line, matching the column order.

description: Ordered page sections rendered by the Next.js section registry.
